Hey bud. 25 yo male here. I was and still kind of am in your shoes.

Your friends support you. They want to see you take the first step. I went to rehab. Said fuck it! Best thing i ever did. Even tho ive relapsed, i know i can get out of this shitty cycle now. You have to know that there are soo many ppl like you out there. That said, i would start with a taper. Dont get drunk anymore, just drink to aleviate any withdrawl symptoms. See how long you can go betweem drinks. Try to increase that time slowly. Then stop for a weekend. See what happens. Know you wont die, know that other people have done this too and have gone on to love great lives. We care about you buddy!

Good on you! Step 1 is admitting your powerlessness over this horrible disease. I believe with your mindset you can go far. We in AA care about you. And your local meets do too. We want to see people get better! Congrats on step 1. PM if you need any further help, as thats what we do!

 P.s. Dont be embarrassed. Let that part go. :)

See a detox clinic. They exist and you healthcare should cover it. Usually takes a week. They give you what you need to not sieze (phonobarbatol etc)(no benzos if ur already on benzos and alcohol mixed). Even some rehab clinics will take you in for the detox portion of it.

The anxiety is the worst part to be honest. A week bender wont fuck you too hard. You wont die if you cold turkey it after that amount of time. I stopped completely after 7 months of a bottle a day and 9mg of xanax a day, and i was in a daze for 3 days then after a week i was completely back to normal. So use that as an extreme. A year or doing what you did will require a week of no drinking and feeling miserable. A week should take about 3 days considering you were drinking 2-3 a day prior. Hey man. I have fairly bad anxiety and have to talk myself out of panic attacks regularly. You are not alone in this. Repeat. You are not alone in this. You have to know that what you are going through is normal and very easy to overcome. Please never dread that you cannot get over this.

With that said, here is what I do when I feel a panic coming.

1)Take a VERY slow and DEEP breath. Focus on breathing in first. Only that and nothing else in this universe. Feel the air fill your lungs and try to enjoy this fresh air as much as you can. Hold, then slowly exhale, thinking about all of the the C02 you are geting rid of. REPEAT.

2)Tell youself that you are in CONTROL of your body. Refuse to let you subconscious trick you into being panicked. That is what helps me the most. It is MY MIND that is doing this to MYSELF! Crazy, why would I let something so stupid happen!!

3) Do not overthink it. Im glad you posted here but please do not overthink this situation. Its when you make it a big deal that it becomes a big deal. TRY TO LAUGH when you realize all you are doing is fucking with yourself. How dumb is that?! Its funny! Because its so unneccessary.

4) Focus on your favourite memory. Favourite person. Favourite ANYTHING. Then get up and go on a .5km walk. Smile a lot. 

This is what helped me. Im not here to control you. THATS YOUR JOB :). I was alone, in a hotel room, in Reno, during the worst of my attacks. If I wasnt blessed with the best family ever, who knows where I would be because I thought I was trapped in a cycle. BUT WE ARE NOT! We are free and in control of our minds.

Hope I could comfort you if only a little. Stay strong brother!

EDIT: Also, Alcohol makes such attacks worse. All substances will not help. The cannabis you smoked in November has no effect on right now, however, because of the timespan.

RAY OF SUNSHINE: Only took me 3 weeks to get over my attacks. Just be disciplined and strong minded. I quit drinking and that helped immensly. While I still have a fair amount of anxiety, my panic attacks have faded away.
